notes: Deploy the accepted src/MemecoinCemetery.sol:MemecoinCemetery application on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663) with no constructor arguments, zero deployment ETH and no initialization calls. The application is tokenless, ownerless and immutable, with no fees, administrator, upgrade or pause mechanism. The factory receives no privileges. receive and fallback always revert; application functions are nonpayable. No token transfers or approvals are required. Anyone may dig a token with code and a positive, readable totalSupply using one of the 24 fixed epitaphs (indices 0-23), opening a 72-hour wake. Before its deadline, a qualifying holder may call itLives to save the token. At or after the deadline, anyone may seal an unopposed wake. While Buried, each address may mourn once per burial, and a qualifying holder may call rise. Saved and Risen tokens may enter another wake after a seven-day cooldown; lifetime burial, rise and save counters never reset. Holder eligibility uses the current balance and max(1, min(10**decimals, floor(totalSupply/1000))); unavailable, malformed or greater-than-36 decimals default to 18. Borrowed and flash-loaned balances qualify. Token reads are static, capped at 50,000 gas and return-size checked. graveOf exposes the latest attempt; burialOf exposes permanent numbered burial records whose identity and dates remain fixed, with mourners increasing only while that burial is active. cooldownEndsAt exposes the next eligible wake time. graveCount counts currently Buried tokens; recentBurials returns at most 20 seals newest first, retaining repeated and risen tokens. headstone renders an on-chain SVG with XML-escaped printable token metadata or a shortened-address fallback, the fixed epitaph, UTC dates, mourners and a RISEN banner when applicable. Build settings are Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer 200 and bytecode_hash none as pinned in foundry.toml. Deployment and explorer source verification are subsequent network-deployer steps; this manifest does not claim either has occurred.
